facts.fact: Tech-Connect says Law n°2014-006 on cybercrime is currently in force in Madagascar and defines offences such as fraudulent access to an information system.
Tech-Connect says bill 042/2026, a 96-article replacement cybercrime law, had its National Assembly examination postponed sine die as at 5 September 2026.

MDG.note: The bill's data-jurisdiction principle covers all data generated or processed in Madagascar, not state data specifically, and the bill was postponed.
